children: may retrace into a range of $99.47 to $100.50 per barrel, as it faces a strong resistance at $103.82.
A projection analysis reveals this barrier at the 100% level, which serves as one of the endpoints of a wave c from $95.12.
A rising channel points at the target zone formed by the 50% and the 61.8% levels. A break above $103.82 may lead to a gain into the $105.09-$107.15 range.
Signals on the daily continuous chart
indicates a resumption of the rise after the correction, as the contract managed to stabilize around the support at $98 and bounced strongly.
The big white candlestick on Thursday signals a strong bullish momentum, which is likely to push the prices higher.
